description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Sequential' that extends 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array' to process data labels sequentially, returning the next label each time it's called. It is part of the Image_Graph package, specifically in the DataPreprocessor subpackage, used for formatting values in graph rendering.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Sequential
classes.description: A class that formats data by returning the next label in a sequential data array, inheriting from Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the next value from the internal data array, effectively providing sequential formatting of labels.
